An Ordinance to amend the Town of Pine Mountain Ordinance to ensure compliance with existing federal, state, and local law with respect to fats, oils, and greases (collectively, “FOG”) traps/interceptors, and to prevent excessive FOG from entering the Town of Pine Mountain Sewer System; to provide an effective date to repeal all ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith; and for other purposes.

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain adopted a comprehensive ordinance to regulate FOG traps and interceptors, which was signed into law on March 8, 2021 (the “FOG Ordinance”); and

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain has determined that the requirements of the FOG Ordinance with respect to in-ground traps and interceptors are impossible to meet in certain locations within the Town of Pine Mountain that are built on a concrete slab and lack any other area in which to install an in-ground trap or interceptor in accordance with the FOG Ordinance; and

WHEREAS, with respect to those locations for which an in-ground device is impossible, the Town of Pine Mountain desires to adopt a variance procedure, whereby the operator of a business requiring an FOG trap or interceptor may petition the Town Council for a variance to utilize an under-sink trap or interceptor if such operator can meet certain objective requirements; and

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain desires to amend the FOG Ordinance to adopt and implement such variance procedure.

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, HARRIS COUNTY, GEORGIA, AND BY AUTHORITY OF THE SAME, IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED AS FOLLOWS:
1:
That Subsection (d)(2) of the FOG Ordinance is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following is inserted in lieu thereof:

P063 1-0022.3291442v2

“(2) Under-sink/compartmental devices. Subject to the variance procedure set forth herein for existing facilities for which the installation of a conforming device is impossible, undersink/compartmental devices are not permitted by users who are subject to this ordinance.”
2:
That the FOG Ordinance is hereby amended to add the following Subsection (g)(4):

- (4) Variances. Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, the Town of Pine Mountain acknowledges that compliance with this ordinance may be impossible in certain locations within the Town of Pine Mountain and hereby establishes a procedure by which it may grant a variance to a user subject to this ordinance to utilize a nonconforming device under the following limited circumstances and upon the following terms and conditions:

- (i) The user subject to this ordinance seeking a variance shall make an application for variance to the Town Council by obtaining and completing an application form held by the Town Clerk and paying the application fee of $100.00;

- (ii) |The user, through its application, must demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Town Council that (1) the user’s establishment is located in a existing structure; (2) said structure is built on a concrete slab; (3) the property surrounding the structure, if any, is insufficient for the installation of a device conforming to the requirements of this ordinance; and (4) the user’s use and anticipated FOG release is not incompatible with an under-sink or compartmental device.

- (iii) Should the Town Council grant a variance, the user must install and maintain its nonconforming device in accordance with the United States Plumbing Code and applicable law.

- (iv) Upon the grant of a variance, the user may not change its use of the establishment in any way or manner that would result

P063 1-0022.3291442v2

in a material increase in FOG. The user shall be charged an annual fee of $50.00 by the Town of Pine Mountain for inspections related to variance compliance.

- (v) Inthe event the Town of Pine Mountain determines at any time that the user or the use of the property is (1) no longer in compliance with the requirements for variance set forth in subsection (ii) above or (2) is reasonably likely to result in blockages or other harm to the Town of Pine Mountain Sewer System, the Town of Pine Mountain shall provide written notice of such noncompliance to the user and the user shall have thirty (30) days from the receipt of such notice to come into compliance. In the event the user remains noncompliant after said thirty (30) day period, the Town may, at its option, terminate the business license associated with the user and/or the property.

- (vi) The variance provided for herein shall not be transferrable.

- (vii) With the exception of the type of device installed, the user shall otherwise comply with the ordinance.

Section Three.

All ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.

Section Four.

This amendment shall become effective on June 13, 2022.
